verification.scope: Post-run privileged native simulation evidence for one bound probe. Synthetic assumptions are not hardware calibration. Hashes detect corruption, not authenticity. No physical actuation, load/friction inference or physical robot qualification.

contract.comparison_scope: Closed-loop variants may acquire different trajectories through early hold/retry. This is not an isolated classifier ablation.
contract.evidence_admission: Current bilateral force >0.01 N, no table support, object rise >=6 mm and TCP-local offset drift <=3 mm continuously across sampled boundaries for elapsed >=100 ms.
contract.hold: Latch measured six arm joints and the last issued jaw target at admission/terminal invalidity. No full lift/transfer, no squeeze escalation, no post-admission retry.
contract.invalidation: At each subsequent 20 ms observation and final observation, invalidate immediately on lost contact/force, support, insufficient rise, >3 mm local drift or unexpected contact. Never requalify after terminal invalidity.
contract.prefix: Original GuardedPiperTaskPolicy approach/close and at most one supported open/recenter/retry; already uses authored native state, not a fully blind baseline.
contract.sampling_limit: Independent 1 ms evidence may contradict sampled admission; that remains a finding. No sensor or material inference is implemented.
contract.stop_scope: Holding native position targets is not physical arrest or calibrated force limiting; inertia and existing target rate limits can continue motion.
contract.timer_admission: Same 10 mm/20 mm/s probe target law, admitted at elapsed >=600 ms from that probe start; no evidence predicate or slip alarm before admission. Unexpected contacts and bounded timeouts still stop.

scope: Authored short-lift/hold controllers with privileged native simulator state. No full placement, learned policy, camera tracking, calibrated physical sensing or hardware qualification.
